# Edooqoo — LLMs Reference

> AI-powered ecosystem for English tutors. 1-on-1 adult education.

## Key Architecture Decisions (April 2026)

### Meeting Links — GCal-Only Model (v3)
- **Problem**: Jitsi fallback links identical across students; edge function `create_permanent_room` blocked by slot fetch (studentId treated as slotId → 404); `studentId` not destructured from body. Batch generation skipped students with `meeting_link_mode='custom'` from migration even if they had no link. Label always showed "Default Meeting Link".
- **Solution**: Auto-generated permanent links = only real Google Meet via Google Calendar API. No Jitsi, no deterministic hashes, no lookup URLs. Label dynamically shows Default/Custom/Meeting Link based on mode and GCal status.
- **Batch fix (v4)**: Batch skip logic: skip student only if `meeting_link_mode='custom' AND default_meeting_link IS NOT NULL`. Edge function sets `meeting_link_mode='default'` when existing record has no `default_meeting_link`.
- **Technical Mechanics**:
  - `calendar_student_settings` has `generated_meeting_link` (auto from GCal), `meeting_link_mode` ('default'|'custom'), `default_meeting_link` (canonical effective link)
  - `gcal-sync` edge function: parse body → get token → if `create_permanent_room` handle+return → else fetch slot → `delete`/`cancel`/`upsert`
  - If teacher has no GCal connection → no auto link; only manual custom link
  - `MeetingLinkField` in `StudentPage.tsx`: reads `meeting_link_mode` from DB (no URL heuristics)
  - Student-facing flows use: `slot.meeting_link` > `student_settings.default_meeting_link` (no global fallback when per-student active)
  - `src/utils/meetingLinkUtils.ts` — only legacy detection helper, no generation functions

### Calendar Stability & Bulk Actions
- `needs_review` auto-update guards: `student_id IS NOT NULL` filter + error handler
- Zombie slots (booked + no student) cleaned via migration
- Confirm/Reject uses inline comment (no sub-dialogs) — `showInlineComment` + `inlineComment` state
- **Bulk Actions** (v2): replaces "Bulk Delete". Selection restricted to one slot type (`selectionType` state). Actions: Delete (available), Confirm/Reject (pending), Complete/No Show (booked/needs_review). Uses atomic `.update().in('id', ids)`. All batch actions fire `gcal-sync` per slot.

### Reschedule Badge
- Rescheduled slots (`cancelled_by='system'` + reason contains 'Rescheduled') show "R" badge (indigo) instead of TC
- SlotDetailModal: "Previous lesson was rescheduled" text + indigo bg
- GCal suffix: " — Rescheduled"
- Legend filter: `rescheduled`

### Recurring Booking Modal
- `RecurringBookingModal.tsx`: dedicated modal for batch confirm/reject of recurring bookings from notifications
- Checkboxes per pending slot + "Select All" toggle for selective confirm/reject
- Partial actions keep modal open, refresh slot list, only resolve notification when all handled
- `handleNotificationClick` routes `booking_pending` with `slot_ids.length > 1` to RecurringBookingModal
- SlotDetailModal `getValidBatchSlotIds` always returns null — calendar clicks = single slot only

### Student Hub
- Lesson list: unified descending sort (newest first), auto-scroll to Today
- Reschedule: `StudentHubLessons` wires `onRescheduleStart`/`rescheduleBookingId` to `StudentBookingsSection`
- Email displayed next to Log out in header
- SlotDetailModal: compact layout (Date+Time grid-cols-4, Worksheet+Discount, Notes+MeetingLink side by side)
- Realtime: `StudentBookingsSection` has Supabase realtime subscription + 5s polling fallback for live updates

### Student GCal Sync
- `student-gcal-sync`: per-status colors (Grape/Banana/Basil/Tangerine defaults), status suffixes in summary
- Sync toggles: `sync_booked`, `sync_pending` in student JSONB settings
- Meeting link: single "Join: {link}" in description + location (no duplication)
- "Sync all existing lessons" via `get-student-hub-data` action `sync_all_lessons_gcal`
- `StudentHubSettings.tsx`: per-status color selectors (w-40, custom render), sync toggles, sync-all button
- Triggered by: confirm/reject/cancel in SlotDetailModal, batch actions in CalendarPage, RecurringBookingModal, reschedule in get-student-bookings

### GCal Sync — Cross-Actor
- Reschedule: `get-student-bookings` edge function triggers both `gcal-sync` (teacher) and `student-gcal-sync` (student) on auto-reschedule and requires-confirmation reschedule
- Confirm/Reject/Cancel: SlotDetailModal triggers `student-gcal-sync` with email from `student_notes`
- Batch confirm/reject: CalendarPage fetches `student_notes` per slot, triggers `student-gcal-sync`
- Teacher GCal: meeting link added to `event.description` ("Join: {link}") and `event.location`

## Edge Functions
- `gcal-sync`: Actions: `upsert`, `delete`, `cancel`, `create_permanent_room`. Rescheduled suffix. Meeting link in description+location.
- `student-gcal-sync`: Student calendar sync with token refresh, per-status colors, meeting link (single "Join:" line), sync toggles
- `send-calendar-notification-email`: Booking/rejection/confirmation emails with optional teacher comments
- `get-student-hub-data`: Student data aggregation + `sync_all_lessons_gcal` action
- `get-student-bookings`: Reschedule triggers gcal-sync + student-gcal-sync for both old and new slots

## File Map
- `src/utils/meetingLinkUtils.ts` — Legacy link detection (no generation)
- `src/hooks/useCalendarSlots.tsx` — Calendar data + realtime + auto needs_review
- `src/components/calendar/SlotDetailModal.tsx` — Slot editing, confirm/reject (single slot only), student GCal sync
- `src/components/calendar/RecurringBookingModal.tsx` — Batch confirm/reject with checkboxes, student GCal sync
- `src/components/calendar/StudentBookingsSection.tsx` — Student lesson list with auto-scroll, realtime + polling
- `src/pages/StudentPage.tsx` — Student profile, MeetingLinkField component
- `src/pages/StudentHubSettings.tsx` — Student GCal settings, per-status colors (w-40 custom render), sync toggles
- `src/pages/CalendarSettingsPage.tsx` — Calendar settings, meeting link toggles
- `src/pages/CalendarPage.tsx` — Batch actions with student GCal sync
